title: Durchsuchungen nach Brandanschlag im September 2025 auf Berliner Stromnetz

extraction.summaryEn: Police searched about 10 flats and premises in Berlin, Hamburg, North Rhine-Westfalia and Brandenburg in connection with a September 2025 arson attack on electricity pylons that caused a large blackout. Four suspects aged 28 to 36 are investigated for constitutionally hostile sabotage.
